cohort: 2224 nulliparous, term women with cephalic singleton pregnancies at a single teaching institution from 2007 to 2014
finding: There was a 3-fold variation in cesarean delivery rates between individual laborists at the same institution, despite no significant differences in patient characteristics or short-term neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found a three-fold variation in cesarean delivery rates among laborists at the same institution, highlighting the impact of individual physician decision-making on cesarean delivery rates even within a laborist care model.
